{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sith Nova Holocron''' was a device that [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] planned to use to locate Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in order to turn them to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

The Holocron was broken into three pieces, each located on a different [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. One piece was located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], another on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], and the third piece on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Dooku obtained the part on Tatooine, but was stopped on Christophsis by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and an unknown Padawan, and on Rodia by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and the same Padawan.

However, Dooku was able to use the piece he had by harnessing the volcanic energy of the planet [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]]. By channeling the energy into the Holocron piece, he could make it as powerful as a complete Holocron.

The Padawan and Yoda defeated Dooku and recovered the Holocron before Dooku could make use of it.
